visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Reading Does Not Refresh the Entry
visualizerParams.problemDescription: After a is read, b should be the entry that gets evicted and the cache should hold [a, c], but it holds [b, c].

solution.explanation: The third constructor argument selects access order. With false the map keeps insertion order, so reading a does not count as a use, and a (inserted first) is evicted instead of b.
